findings.entity: Man's right hand / razor contact point (real body vs mirror reflection)
findings.invariant_violated: contact-point consistency between body and its reflection
findings.description: From 02:25 to 04:00 the real hand grips a dark object pressed into the hair at the side/top of the head behind the temple, while the mirror reflection shows the hand pressing a white razor blade flat against the centre of the forehead above the brow. The contact location (hair at side of head vs centre forehead) and the gripped object do not correspond, so the reflected contact is not produced by the real hand's contact.

At 09:00 the real hand is raised near the chin with fingers curled but empty and not touching the face, whereas the reflection simultaneously shows the same hand firmly gripping the razor with the blade in contact with the cheek. The tool reappears in the real hand at 09:25. The reflected contact has no corresponding grip or skin contact in the real body.
